investigation_notes.Description: An unusually high number of SharePoint downloads (290 vs 24-hour baseline 50) was observed from the user account on the finance site, pulling multiple financial reports and exports. The activity was performed via the Directo MSGraph application with an automated-style user agent and the source/destination IPs returned clean reputations and no recent similar alerts or events. Given the integration context (Directo export paths and finance documents) and the lack of malicious IP or historical indicators, this appears to be a legitimate automated data export rather than confirmed exfiltration, so it is classified as low priority.
